reason: A local DeepSeek Harness plugin focused on replacing the interface background and applying translucent visual styling, with optional user-provided local images.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供可更换的本地背景图片和半透明面板样式。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with a replaceable local background image and translucent styling for interface panels.

capabilities: customizes the DeepSeek Harness web interface background
applies translucent styling to chat, sidebar, and settings panels
reads a user-specified local image path and falls back to a bundled image
modifies plugin and profile configuration during installation
